title: Schema Update Self-Quiescence and Failure Truth Fix
summary: Prevents the schema update pipeline from treating its own advisory-lock connection as a foreign database writer and reports schema preparation failures truthfully.
changelog: Excludes the schema pipeline's own advisory-lock backend from writer quiescence checks.
Keeps real external database sessions blocking schema mutation until the database is quiescent.
Classifies schema preparation failures separately from Docker image build failures.
Shows a localized schema preparation failure and safe retry guidance in Maintenance.
Adds a real PostgreSQL regression test for the owned-lock and external-writer cases.
Does not change database schema, update topology, rollback architecture or the Stage 6.6.1 boundary.
